answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases thus burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the willow deposit is held in the quartz escrow, the zenith audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 73 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. That is 11 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
